title: CityReal: Human-Aligned Urban Behavior and City Dynamics Simulation with Large-Scale LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2608.16897v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large-scale urban simulation plays a pivotal role in social science, traffic safety, and transportation policy. Recent work has shown that large language models, when prompted as agents, can generate lifelike daily routines at city scale. Yet these methods typically rely on few-shot prompting, causing agents to reproduce the LLM's behavioral priors rather than the target population. We introduce CityReal, a modular framework for human-aligned urban simulation. CityReal models agents as intention-driven decision makers that pursue coherent mobility and activity plans rather than isolated step-by-step choices. They adapt over time by learning habits and preferences based on experience and constraints. To improve population-level realism, we learn textual adapters for behavior modules that align agent decisions with observed population statistics. translated_title: CityReal：基于大规模LLM智能体的人类对齐城市行为与城市动态模拟
translated_abstract: 大规模城市模拟在社会科学、交通安全和交通政策中发挥着关键作用。近期研究表明，当大型语言模型被提示为智能体时，能够在城市尺度上生成逼真的日常活动模式。然而，这些方法通常依赖少样本提示，导致智能体复现LLM的行为先验，而非目标人群的行为。我们引入了CityReal，一个用于人类对齐城市模拟的模块化框架。CityReal将智能体建模为意图驱动的决策者，追求连贯的移动性和活动计划，而非孤立的逐步选择。它们通过基于经验和约束学习习惯和偏好，随时间适应变化。为了提高群体层面的真实性，我们学习了行为模块的文本适配器，使智能体决策与观测到的群体统计对齐。实验表明，CityReal在微观和宏观层面均提高了与现实人类行为的一致性。
tldr: 本论文提出CityReal框架，通过意图驱动建模和文本适配器学习，使大规模LLM智能体在城市模拟中更准确对齐真实人类行为。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces CityReal, a framework that improves alignment of large-scale LLM agents with real human behavior in urban simulation via intention-driven modeling and textual adapter learning.
